notes: The expletive 'there' rides inside the unit of the expressed finite verb ὤφθη as a rule 7 helper; rule 96's expletive clause is about a verbless clause and is corroboration here rather than the licence.
αὐτοῖς takes 'unto them' whole: no article stands to anchor the case preposition, so rule 21's determinerless clause keeps it on the pronoun.
μετ' takes 'with' under rule 36, the participle συλλαλοῦντες keeping only 'talking'.
